name: memail_search
description: Full-text search the cached mail by keyword — matches across subject, sender name/address, and body text (Postgres full-text search). Pass a natural query in `q` (e.g. 'overdue invoice', 'flight confirmation', 'alice project update'); results are newest-first, `limit` default 50 / max 200. Returns the same summary shape as memail_list ({ query, messages: [...] }, no body). This is the primary way to answer 'did I get an email about X?' — prefer it over paging memail_list. Follow up with memail_get on a result's `id` for the full message.

q.description: Search text; matched against subject, sender, and body.
